summary: Preserve exact digit-bearing RFI and Submittal identifiers with alphabetic project or discipline prefixes across body text, filenames and workflow indexing without fuzzy matching.
decision_refs: Active user goal to improve accuracy and adaptability for RFI, Submittal and Email content
Direct reproduction where ARC-0042, MEP-023 and SUB-001 all normalized to null
Existing exact identifier and distinct-group workflow policy
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Compact prefixed identifiers allow bounded alphanumeric segments separated by period, underscore, slash or hyphen; arbitrary prose and fuzzy variants are not linked.
Spaced identifiers remain limited to the existing CSI-style Submittal grammar.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer document, mailbox or paid provider was used.
